title: How A Gas Pump Knows Your Tank Is Full
hook: A machine reads your car without any electronics at all.

cast.note: Gus runs the station. He knows how it works and has never once been asked.

scenes.note: Bill is mid-fill at frame 0. Pump, nozzle, car all legible immediately.

beats.action: Bill holding the nozzle in the car's filler neck, bored, looking away
the pump display flashes FULL and the nozzle clicks; Bill jumps
a dashed 'signal' line tries to connect nozzle to car, then snaps and falls; a NO card lands on it

scenes.note: The mechanism scene. Camera dives into the nozzle tip; this is the money diagram.

beats.action: camera dives from the pump down the hose into a side-on cutaway of the nozzle tip
the tiny sensing hole pops on near the tip, circled coral
the air passage draws itself from the hole back up the nozzle body as a teal channel

scenes.note: Normal operation. Air flows. Establish the baseline so the change reads.

beats.action: fuel streams down the nozzle; the tank level starts rising
little air arrows run freely up the passage past the open hole
beats.sync: keyword: air can move through it

scenes.note: The turn. Fuel reaches the hole and the air arrows die. Do not rush this.

beats.action: the fuel level in the filler neck climbs toward the sensing hole
fuel seals the hole; it goes dark; the air arrows stall and turn coral
the air passage flashes and empties; a vacuum symbol pops at its top

scenes.note: The payoff of the mechanism. The diaphragm snaps, the valve drops, on the word 'click'.

beats.action: the diaphragm chamber pops into the cutaway and starts flexing
the diaphragm sucks inward hard; a linkage arm cocks
CLICK card slams in; the whole frame jolts; impact lines
beats.sync: keyword: click — the word and the mechanism land together

beats.action: the valve plate drops shut; the fuel stream cuts to nothing mid-air

scenes.note: Three denials, three props popping out of existence. Rhythmic.

beats.action: a wifi icon pops in over the pump and is immediately crossed out and gone
a little computer pops in and is crossed out
a dashed secret-signal beam pops in between car and pump and is crossed out; Bill blinks

scenes.note: Gus has been standing there the whole time. Smallest possible reaction closes the episode.

beats.action: the nozzle floats up beside Bill with a tiny halo; he looks at it with new respect
sparkles burst around the nozzle; Bill is genuinely impressed
Gus, who has been in frame the entire scene, gives one slow nod; hard cut
